posts.cooked:
First time poster, long time lurker.

I got the unlock, but can't offer a log unfortunately, as I was playing on my phone (screenshot here: https://imgur.com/a/PN7Gx)

 

Playing vs. Ambuscade in Court of Blood.

Legacy, F6 Tachyon, Dark Visionary, RC Wraith and Fanatic.

All Vampires entered play and were destroyed by Fanatic herself, and we finished up with Sacrosanct, Zealous Offense, Embolden and Undaunted, as well as both of her equipment cards (Edited for accuracy) in play, and with Fanatic dealing the final blow (though I'm not sure that's actually a part of the unlock since the other three don't seem to be dependent on that).

Other things which could be of note: Hunter Fulepet never entered play, Twist the Ether on Visionary meant that Fanatic was pumping out a tremendous amount of Radiant Damage. When Unhallowed Halls was out, she was using almost exclusively Infernal Damage to get the buff. If I can think of anything else that might be of use I'll edit this post.

I'm a little disappointed that my idea of 'do all the things to Vampires in Court of Blood' is probably correct, but I ruined it by playing End of Days.

I have what may be a useful non-unlock. RC Wraith / SS Tachyon / Visionary / Fanatic, Court of Blood, Gloomweaver.

- Fanatic destroyed each Vampire with Radiant damage (a couple of them twice, since the deck cycled).

- Fanatic only played one-shots and used her base power the entire match.

- It was a Relic victory and one Vampire had come back out into play just before the match ended.

So, I'm not sure what part of that was the problem - the lack of any ongoings (one person on Steam reports only having Undaunted out)? the fact that a vampire was active? The fact that the villain was not KO'd?

posts.name: ringer
posts.cooked:
Just played a game, and got the unlock.  Here are the details.

Villain - Ambuscade

Environment - Court of Blood

Heroes

1.  Standard Fanatic

2.  Standard Legacy

3.  Rookv City Wraith

4.  Dark Visionary

Fanatics setup

1. Absolution

2. Aegis of Resurrection

3. Zealous Offense

4.  Divine Retribution

During the game, Fanatic had twist the Aether from Visionary, converting all damage to radiant.  RCW was used to speed up the environment, playing out all the Vampires.  Fanatic KO'd all vampires with radiant damage.  She was the only hero to KO a target, though one of the vampires KO'ed one of Ambuscade's guns.  She KO'ed the villain to win, using Divine Focus for the KO damage.  Divine Focus was only out at the end, and did not contribute a lot of damage to the effort at all.  The KO damage type was radiant.
